name: f3-lean-climb-v1
hypothesis: After each promotion the caps jump and stories alone lift Network and Output too slowly to reach the next bar within one half-year (the black-box study needs a large Network and Output jump at L3). A Skill that sends quarter-end Energy and main actions to Network and Output right after a promotion, and to Skill once Network and Output stall, will raise the level reached by month 18.
predicted_behaviour: More Prepare report materials, Network maintenance and key-project or report-results main actions in the two allocations after a promotion; more promotions at the second and third reviews; higher mean level at month 18 than the same-batch reference.
refutation: Refuted if the mean level at month 18 over 25 games per arm is not above the interleaved reference, or if promotions at reviews 2 and 3 among games promoted at review 1 do not rise.
